data.description: Luxury Redefined | Prime Location in Damac Hills | Unbeatable Offer
data.display_address: Veneto at Damac Hills, DAMAC Hills, Dubai
data.long_description:
Presenting an extraordinary 6-bedroom villa with a maid's room, located in the prestigious Veneto community within Damac Hills. This property, proudly offered by Provident Real Estate, embodies the essence of modern luxury and sophisticated living. Designed with the finest materials and top-tier finishes, this villa offers a unique blend of elegance, comfort, and functionality.

Property Highlights:

Luxuriously Upgraded: This villa has been meticulously upgraded to provide an unmatched living experience. Spanning 10,956 sq. ft., it features high-quality finishes that enhance every corner of the home. From the chic, contemporary design to the thoughtful layout, this property is a true masterpiece.

Spacious and Elegant Layout: With 6 expansive bedrooms and 7 bathrooms, this villa offers ample space for relaxation and entertaining. The maid’s room adds an extra layer of convenience. The living room and master bedroom have been extended to create larger, more comfortable spaces, filled with natural light from the floor-to-ceiling windows.

Exceptional Amenities: The villa is equipped with an array of luxury amenities designed for your ultimate comfort and enjoyment. Dive into your private swimming pool with an integrated Jacuzzi, entertain guests at the outdoor bar, or enjoy a movie night in the private, soundproof cinema room. For fitness enthusiasts, there is a fully-equipped gym, and the fire pit relaxation area provides a perfect setting for unwinding after a long day.

Modern and Thoughtful Design: The interiors have been crafted with an eye for detail, featuring exquisite finishes and modern fixtures. The open-plan living areas flow seamlessly, creating an inviting atmosphere that’s perfect for both family living and hosting gatherings. The villa’s design maximizes natural light, creating a bright and airy ambiance throughout.

Breathtaking Views: Enjoy stunning views of the Trump Golf Course from your private pool and various vantage points within the villa. The serene and picturesque surroundings add to the allure of this exceptional property, offering a tranquil retreat within the vibrant community of Damac Hills.

Advanced Security and Convenience: Safety and convenience are paramount in this villa, with 24/7 surveillance ensuring peace of mind. The property is also within walking distance of world-class amenities, including shopping, dining, and recreational facilities, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a luxurious yet practical lifestyle.
